title: Segra International is now offering cannabis meristem clean-stock to licensed nurseries
body: We launched commercial-scale cannabis tissue culture and HLVd remediation from our lab. Virus-free mother stock and meristem service for breeders. Hiring a micropropagation technician. Partnership inquiries welcome.
author: Segra International

title: New West Genetics ships a genomic prediction panel for cannabis breeders
body: The company opened a lab and now offering genomic selection scores, SNP genotyping, and chemotype prediction for seedmakers. Marker-assisted breeding index is the product they are selling into a crowded market of cannabis testing labs.
author: AgTech Wire

title: Meristem tip culture eliminates hop latent viroid from Cannabis sativa
body: We report a novel protocol for HLVd remediation via meristem tissue culture. Pathogen-free plantlets showed higher survival and reduced contamination versus standard micropropagation. First report of temporary immersion with meristem-tip cannabis. DOI: 10.0000/demo
author: Cannabis Lab

title: Is cannabis TC saturated or is every nursery just adding meristem?
body: The market is flooded. Too many clone companies, another tissue culture lab every week, race to the bottom on clean stock. Everyone is doing HLVd remediation and nothing new in the protocols. Barrier to entry is low.
author: u/meristematic

title: HEK293 mammalian cell culture scaffold for tissue engineering
body: iPSC and organoid work in a clinical trial setting. Mammalian HEK293 culture only.
author: Oncology Lab

title: How I run a kitchen tissue culture hood for orchids
body: Explant to flask walkthrough using MS medium, BAP, and PPM. Contamination rate dropped after switching brands. Shop now for the same jars I use.
author: Kitchen Culture Kits

title: Medicinal Genomics publishes a CRISPR-ready cannabis genome and pathogen panel
body: Breakthrough whole-genome resource plus qPCR for hop latent viroid. Sequencing and bioinformatics for predictive breeding. Peer-reviewed preprint.
author: Medicinal Genomics

title: cannabis-gblup
body: Open source genomic selection notes for Cannabis sativa breeding values, GBLUP, and chemotype prediction.
author: demo
